projects.title: SmartScraper - Web Data Collector & Report Generator
projects.subtitle: An automated web scraping tool that collects data from websites, processes it with Pandas, and generates professional Excel & PDF reports with daily scheduling support.
projects.problem: Businesses and researchers waste hours manually copying data from websites. There was no simple tool to automate data collection and instantly generate clean, professional reports.
projects.solution: Built a complete pipeline that scrapes 1000+ records from static and dynamic websites, cleans and analyzes the data with Pandas, and automatically generates formatted Excel and PDF reports with a single command.
key_features: Static & dynamic scraping with Requests, BeautifulSoup, and Selenium
Automated Excel report with 4 sheets and PDF report with 3 pages
Daily scheduling with logging support via schedule library

projects.title: Expense Tracker - Personal Finance Manager
projects.subtitle: A full-stack personal finance tracking app with FastAPI backend, SQLite database, Pandas analysis, AI-powered category suggestion, and PDF report generation.
projects.problem: People struggle to track their daily expenses and understand their spending habits. Most tools are either too complex or lack meaningful analysis and reporting features.
projects.solution: Built a full-stack expense tracker with a FastAPI REST API backend and a clean HTML/CSS/JS frontend. Includes AI-powered category suggestion based on keywords, interactive charts, and one-click PDF report download.
key_features: AI-powered category auto-suggestion based on expense title
Interactive dashboard with Chart.js doughnut and bar charts
One-click PDF report generation with summary, category breakdown, and full expense table
